# Deluxe to Webcast Upcoming Investor Day Activities


November 25, 2026 4:30 pm EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_a822c1fa557b3644acb4ae4543bfbf5f/deluxe/news/2026-11-25_Deluxe_to_Webcast_Upcoming_Investor_Day_489.pdf)


MINNEAPOLIS--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Deluxe (NYSE: DLX), a trusted Payments and Data company, will be hosting an Investor Day presentation at the Four Seasons Hotel New York located at 57 East 57th Street on Wednesday, December 2 beginning at 9:00am ET.


Interested parties should RSVP via email (investor.relations@deluxe.com ) to register for in-person attendance; capacity is limited.


The event will also be livestreamed. Remote attendees can register for the live webcast of the event from this[link](https://dlxinvestorday26.us.chime.live/app) or via the investor relations section of the company’s website at[www.investors.deluxe.com](http://www.investors.deluxe.com/) . A replay of the webcast will be available following the event.


**About Deluxe**


Deluxe, a trusted Payments and Data company, champions business so communities thrive. Our solutions help businesses pay, get paid, and grow. For more than 100 years, Deluxe customers have relied on our solutions and platforms at all stages of their lifecycle, from start-up to maturity. Our powerful scale supports millions of small businesses, thousands of vital financial institutions and hundreds of the world’s largest consumer brands, while processing more than $2 trillion in annual payment volume. Our reach, scale and distribution channels position Deluxe to be our customers’ most trusted business partner. To learn how we can help your business, visit us at[www.deluxe.com](http://www.deluxe.com/) .
